high: The retained V3163 init is not previously device-proven: its public record explicitly says source-build PASS and Device flash: no, no V3163 live report or private run evidence was found, and the original V3163 boot image/manifest needed to reconstruct its complete boot closure is absent.

The requested candidate-demo-rollback sequence is not represented by the current reviewed minimal F1 owner. That owner performs candidate resident health and rolls back only on attributable failure; it has no bounded Bad Apple observation and no intentional rollback of a healthy candidate after filming. A successful install therefore cannot be relabelled as the requested temporary demo transaction.

GOAL_A90 exact current state says no H36 identity or authority exists and the selected bounded unit remains H0 architecture work that does not build a successor. A goal cannot grant authority, but its unresolved selected state prevents this review from treating H36 as the current qualified candidate.
medium: Independent unpack confirms header, kernel, and kernel_dtb are byte-identical to V3402 and the entry-name set is unchanged, but /init changes from V3402 1000:1000 mode 0755 size 1855248 to H36 0:0 mode 0750 size 1461520. The V3163 init also names /bin/a90_doomgeneric_private_engine_v3163, while the V3402 carrier contains only the v3402 engine. This cross-generation ramdisk/init compatibility is designed-unproved, not inherited from V3402 live PASS.

The private manifest binds the 150490668-byte stream and correctly states that cache presence, playback, display, boot, and final health are unproved, but no fresh exact device-side cache identity or bounded 300-frame observation is bound into an F1 qualification. Host stream identity alone cannot establish the intended evidence video.

The focused tests only inspect constants and private output paths. They do not execute the builder, pin magiskboot bytes, compare boot components and complete ramdisk metadata, prove the four intended identity substitutions, reject the absent V3163 helper, or validate a demo-and-rollback transaction.
